This establishes large-scale domestic Indian turnover (a listed BSE:500096 / NSE:DABUR entity with audited consolidated revenue), i.e. actual domestic supply activity, though the exact GST turnover band and GeM/CPPP contract rows were not retrieved.
note: Legal name in the request is misspelled ('DABAR'); the entity is Dabur India Limited, CIN not verified in this session (not retrieved from a primary registry — left null rather than guessed).
